name: Itazura Teacher ~Himitsu no Hokenshitsu~
original_name: いたずらてぃーちゃー ～秘密の保健室～
source:
"Teacher!! Hazuki-chan got hit by a ball!!"

I was the gym teacher... A little girl seemed dizzy so we went to the school clinic together.

... But nobody was there... No nurse or female doctor or teacher.

She really seemed ready to faint... What should I do?...

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ093680.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
